# R Figure and Diagnostic Package Map

## Role

SimItAll writes a portable base figure set with `ggplot2`, but an R package
exists for many additional diagnostic, locus-level, and interpretation plots.
Use `simitall_figure_tool_catalog()` to inspect installed availability before
selecting an optional backend.

These packages are **optional**, not mandatory dependencies of every SimItAll
run. The agent must select a plot only when its needed input exists. For
example, ChIPQC requires aligned BAM files; a simulated BED peak list alone
cannot produce cross-correlation, fragment-length, or blacklist QC.

## GWAS

| Question | Recommended R packages | Inputs required |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Standard Manhattan and QQ | `qqman`, `CMplot`, `GWASTools` | Association marker table |
| Population/QC PCA and kinship | `SNPRelate`, `GENESIS` | Genotypes and sample metadata |
| Regional association and LD | `locuszoomr`, `LDheatmap` | Lead locus, LD, marker map, annotation |
| Fine mapping / colocalization | `susieR`, `coloc` | Summary statistics and compatible LD/reference data |
| ROC/PR/calibration of synthetic truth | `pROC`, `PRROC`, `yardstick` | Causal-truth labels and association scores |

## Bulk RNA-seq and eQTL

| Question | Recommended R packages | Inputs required |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Differential expression / MA | `DESeq2`, `edgeR`, `limma` | Raw counts and declared design |
| PCA / interactive QC | `PCAtools`, `pcaExplorer`, `Glimma` | Normalized counts and sample metadata |
| Volcano / heatmap | `EnhancedVolcano`, `ComplexHeatmap` | DE results or expression matrix |
| Enrichment | `clusterProfiler`, `fgsea`, `GSVA` | Identifier mapping and gene list/rank |
| Modules / trajectories | `WGCNA`, `maSigPro` | Adequately replicated expression/time-course data |
| Splicing / exon use | `DEXSeq` | Exon-level counts and annotation |
| eQTL FDR, fine mapping, sharing | `qvalue`, `susieR`, `coloc`, `ComplexUpset` | eQTL summaries; GWAS summaries for colocalization |

## ChIP-seq

| Question | Recommended R packages | Inputs required |
| --- | --- | --- |
| BAM-level QC | `ChIPQC` | ChIP and input BAM files, sample sheet |
| Differential binding | `DiffBind`, `csaw` | Replicates, BAM/peak sets, design |
| Peak annotation / TSS profile | `ChIPseeker`, `ChIPpeakAnno` | Peak BED and matching GTF/GFF3 |
| Motifs / signal heatmaps | `motifmatchr`, `universalmotif`, `ComplexHeatmap` | Motif matrices plus sequences/signal matrix |

For bigWig coverage tracks, phantom-peak cross-correlation, IDR, and deep
heatmaps, R usually orchestrates **external** tools such as deepTools, IDR, or
phantompeakqualtools. Do not claim these are created from a peak table alone.

## Single-cell

| Question | Recommended R packages | Inputs required |
| --- | --- | --- |
| QC, UMAP, markers | `Seurat`, `scater`, `scuttle`, `scran` | Cell-by-gene counts and metadata |
| Doublets / integration / clustering | `scDblFinder`, `batchelor`, `clustree` | Raw counts, batches, embeddings/clusters |
| Trajectory | `slingshot`, `tradeSeq` | Reduced dimensions, clusters, pseudotime |
| Communication/CNV | `CellChat`, `infercnv` | Suitable reference/annotation and expression data |

## Breeding and Genomic Selection

| Question | Recommended R packages | Inputs required |
| --- | --- | --- |
| QTL / founder effects | `qtl`, `qtl2` | Cross type, genotypes, marker map, phenotypes |
| Structure / LD / diversity | `vcfR`, `adegenet`, `pegas`, `hierfstat`, `LDheatmap` | VCF/genotypes, marker map, population labels |
| GxE, BLUPs, reaction norms | `sommer`, `metan` | Trait, environment, family/pedigree design |
| Prediction and gain | `rrBLUP`, `BGLR`, `yardstick`, `pROC` | Training genotypes/phenotypes and held-out candidates |

## Cross-Cutting Figures

Use `ComplexUpset` for set overlap, `ComplexHeatmap` for large annotated
matrices, `circlize` for Circos plots, `ggalluvial` for pedigree/flow diagrams,
`igraph` + `ggraph` for networks, and `patchwork` for multi-panel layouts.

## SimItAll Rule

1. Always write the base required figures in `results/<run>/figures/`.
2. Add optional figures only when their inputs are present and their role is
   stated in the result manifest.
3. Preserve the package/version, design formula, filters, and input paths.
4. For simulated data, pair interpretation figures with truth/recovery or a
   declared QC pass criterion.
